overviewHelp: How often each URL appears in AI answers
weekNote: Each point is the total retrievals for that week, starting on Monday.
monthNote: Each point is the total retrievals for that month.
filterChartNote: The filters above also apply to this chart. Reset them to see every line.
chartEmpty: No URL matches these filters. Reset filters to see the chart again.
moversHelp: How often each URL and URL type is retrieved
topTip: URLs with the highest number of retrievals in the selected timeframe
newTip: URLs retrieved for the first time in the selected timeframe
trendingTip: URLs showing the fastest growth in retrieval activity
losingTip: URLs showing the largest decline in retrieval activity
moversEmpty: Nothing is {tab} in this preview. Open Top to see the busiest URLs.
socialHelp: How often URLs from each social channel are retrieved
socialEmpty: No channel is {tab} in this preview. Open Top to see the busiest channels.
gapOn: Gap analysis is on. The list shows pages that mention at least the chosen number of competitors.
gapOff: Gap analysis is off. The list includes pages even when no competitor is mentioned.
noBrandMatch: No brand matches that search. Try another name.
exportEmptyBody: The list is empty. Clear the search or loosen the filters, then export again.
learnMoreBody: A mention is a brand name on the page. It is separate from a citation inside the AI answer.
noSearchBody: Clear the search or try a different word.
noFilterBody: Reset the list filters. The page filters above are separate.
selectPage: Select all rows on this list
showingAll: Showing all {count} URLs in this preview.
showingFiltered: Showing {count} URLs. Reset list filters to see the full set.
daysAgo: {count, plural, =0 {today} =1 {1 day ago} other {# days ago}}
dateMissing: No date was saved for this answer. Refresh the page after the run finishes.
modelCountsMissing: Retrieval counts by model are not available for this period.
missingTitle: This URL is not in the preview
missingBody: Open URLs and choose a page from the list.
retrievalsHelp: No. of times AI uses this URL as a source
citationHelp: Share of answers that cite this URL
promptsHelp: Prompts where this URL was retrieved
firstSeenHelp: The first day this URL showed up in an answer
byModelHelp: No. of times this URL is retrieved in chats
noModels: No model has retrieved this URL in this period.
snapshotMissing: The saved copy of this page will show here after the next run.
promptsSectionHelp: No. of times this URL was retrieved per prompt
noPrompts: No prompts retrieved this URL. Open another URL from the list.
brandsHelp: Frequency and position of brand appearances in this URL
noBrandsOnPage: No tracked brand is mentioned on this page. {brand} is not on it either.
copiedBody: {count} chat titles are on the clipboard.
noChats: No chats match these filters. Clear a filter or the search to see them again.
noTagsYet: No tags yet. Create tags on the Prompts page, then add them here.
